newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL SAY NO BID MADE FOR RIEDLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL SAY NO BID MADE FOR RIEDLE.

text.p: Liverpool said on Monday they had not made an offer for German international striker Karlheinz Riedle despite reports to the contrary from Borussia Dortmund.
"There has been no bid made," a club spokesman said.
Borussia Dortmund's sports director Ottmar Hitzfeld said earlier that the European Cup winners were considering an offer from Liverpool.
"We are in contact with Liverpool and I expect a decision to be made this week," said Hitzfeld, who quit as a coach last month to become the German club's sports director.
According to press reports, Liverpool have offered Riedle a three-year contract for a 4.5-million marks ($2.5-million) transfer fee.
Riedle, whose contract with Dortmund runs until next year, played a key role in last May's European Cup final, scoring two goals to help his side beat Juventus 3-1.
He has also been linked to Italian second division side Perugia, the former club of Dortmund's new coach Nevio Scala.
